items.title: Arizona State tabs two-time PGA Tour winner as newest assistant coach
items.summary: Following the summer departure of assistant Thomas Sutton, who took the head position at Washington, Sun Devils head coach Matt Thurmond took some time in naming Sutton’s replacement: James Hahn.

items.title: J.J. Spaun gets a Presidents Cup snub and then a big win in Europe
items.summary: Presidents Cup captain Brandt Snedeker chose not to use any of his six picks on J.J. Spaun, the 2025 U.S. Open champion and a winner at the Texas Open earlier in the year. Spaun said he was referred to as the “odd man odd” and was surprised and disappointed in being left off the U.S. team. The others were Billy Horschel (twice) and Arnold Palmer.
